description:
In a computer, the **BIOS** is the first thing that runs. Here, it's the first point of contact, where life and computation begin speaking to each other.

**BIOS V2** is CSED's flagship hackathon, run with the **IEEE Student Chapter** at **Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology, Patiala**. It brings **300 shortlisted builders in 60 teams** to campus for **48 hours of building**, from **30 October to 1 November 2026**.

---

## Pick Your Track

### SEED: School Students (Grades 9 to 12)
Problem statements for school students, solved on campus. Seed has two routes:

- **Idea Lab:** for students strongest in research, design and problem solving. Ends in an **evidence-led proposal or low-fidelity prototype** and a **live pitch**.
- **Build Lab:** a supervised build that ends in a **working prototype** and a **technical defence**.

*Both routes get their own stage time and awards.*

### CORE: College Students
Problem statements set at a **more approachable level**. The right starting point for **emerging builders**.

### FRONTIER: College Students
The **hardest problem statements at BIOS**, built for **advanced AI, systems and research work**. Expect **demanding evaluation** and **live technical questioning**.

### FORGE: Industry Partnerships
**Companies write the problem statements**, and screened teams build on them. Teams that perform well get the chance at **2-month and 6-month internships** with the partner company.

---

Expect **AI agents, coding tools and multimodal apps**, with the freedom to **compare and switch models** as you build.

---

## Team Rules

- **Every team must have exactly 4 members.**
- **Every team must include at least 1 female member.** Teams without one will not qualify.

---

## Prizes: $240,000+ (₹2,27,00,000+)

**Cash prizes, platform credits, tools and perks**, with something for the teams that ship.

---

### **Ship something that works. Defend it on stage.**

**Venue:** Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology, Patiala
**Dates:** 30 Oct to 1 Nov 2026
**Website:** [bios.notyouraverage.xyz](https://bios.notyouraverage.xyz/)

sponsors.about: Tin Computer is an autonomous growth agent. It connects to a project's GitHub, analytics and Stripe. It ships pull requests for growth work, including SEO pages, landing-page fixes, ads and support replies. Up to 60 eligible BIOS V2 teams receive $299 in Tin Computer credits, covering one month of Growth.
